_doc: The Academgorodok's 15 residents (docs/people.md): looks (proposals, not canon) and the hi3d reference requests. Each is a multi-view text_to_image task (Nano-Banana 2, front/back/left/right) then a v3.0 high-quality textured model, as REFERENCE only: people.json keeps their current bodies (mesh) until the MetaHuman pipeline (worktree rebuild) turns these into the game's bodies. Task ids and outputs: design/people/<key>/gen.json.
pose: Strict T-pose: standing straight, arms stretched out horizontally to the sides at shoulder height, elbows straight, palms facing down, fingers together, feet shoulder width apart, flat on the floor.
